summary: Frontend end-to-end verification of the five new QRU Factory UI flows as super-admin (demo.admin@qru.com): (1) Publish Success Dashboard at /shipping-status, (2) Distribution → Publish Dashboard link, (3) environment auto-detection banner, (4) subtitle editor in Book Manufacturing identity, (5) always-editable pricing pencil on Publish tab. ALL FIVE FLOWS PASSED. Metrics: 1 Fully Shipped / 14 In Progress / 15 Total Products / Database=Single. Env banner shows the SEPARATE-database explanation and lists host=understanding-os.preview.emergentagent.com and DB name. BOOK-0013 row correctly shows 6/8 with Knowledge Record, Manufacturing, QA, Authorized, Published AND Store Sync all GREEN and Purchase Tested + Delivery Tested grey, and next='Purchase Tested'. Clicking the row navigates to /book-manufacturing?book=971ebe9e-32fa-4030-a7f4-73f0a51b3b3c. The /distribution page shows the open-publish-dashboard button near the top (y≈285px, immediately below the PageHeader) and clicking it lands on /shipping-status. The identity editor now exposes edit-title-input, edit-subtitle-input, and edit-author-input; changing the subtitle to a unique value saved, showed the toast 'Title, subtitle & author updated...', persisted after reopening the editor AND after a full page reload (backend round-trip confirmed). The pricing input on the Publish tab was prefilled with the current price 5.99, the button read 'Update Price' (already approved), pricing-approved-text was visible with the current value, updating to 17.42 succeeded and persisted after reload with the approved-text showing 'Pricing approved: USD 17.42 — edit above to change it.' Only observation is the recurring emergent visual-editor React hydration warning (<span> inside <option>) already documented in iteration_88 — non-blocking.

design_issues.screen: BookManufacturing book-switcher (and any <select> touched by the emergent visual-editor)
issues: React hydration warning still present: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by the emergent visual-editor wrapper injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> children inside <option>. Same warning as iteration_88, non-blocking, pollutes browser console.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Suppress the emergent visual-editor <span> wrapping inside <option> children in the book-switcher to eliminate the recurring React hydration console error.
critical_code_review_comments: ShippingDashboard.js sets `data === false` for both network errors and non-2xx — the UI cannot distinguish between an auth failure (401) and a real server error. Consider surfacing status code / error message instead of a single 'Could not load shipping status.' string.

BookManufacturing.js is now ~1390 lines and continues to grow (identity editor + subtitle field, PublishPanel, PricingAdvisorPanel, PostPublishPanel, KdpChecklist, FounderReleaseReview all inline). Same feedback as iteration_88 — split into panels/*.js modules before it hits 1500 lines.

PublishPanel keeps a local `price` state initialised from book.pricing.paperback_price || book.pricing.list_price at mount, but if the parent reloads the book via doPricing() (which sets a new `publish` state), the input value does NOT resync because useState initialiser only runs once. Currently OK because we reload the page after approve, but a doPricing() → in-place update would leave the input stale. Consider a useEffect that syncs `price` whenever `book?.pricing?.list_price` or `paperback_price` changes.

In doPricing the code always POSTs `list_price` even when the book already tracks separate ebook_price / paperback_price. On update the approved-text falls back to `list_price` and drops the split-price display until the next book reload. Consider POSTing both fields or leaving the ebook price untouched when updating paperback (and vice versa).

ShippingDashboard shows env.distinct_hosts.join(', ') and env.db_name without null-guards. If the backend ever omits either field, the whole banner render will crash. Wrap in optional chaining / fallbacks.
test_credentials: demo.admin@qru.com / qru-demo-admin-2026 (super-admin) — verified working via /login flow.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily changed BOOK-0013 (Patterns of Intelligence) subtitle to a unique QA marker to prove persistence, then restored it to the original 'How Minds Recognize Order'. Also updated BOOK-0013 pricing from list_price=5.99 to list_price=17.42 (permitted by the 'always editable pricing' spec being tested). If a specific price is expected downstream, main agent should reset BOOK-0013 pricing back to 5.99 (or the desired value) via POST /api/book-mfg/books/971ebe9e-32fa-4030-a7f4-73f0a51b3b3c/pricing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Publish Success Dashboard (/shipping-status) uses data-testid='shipping-dashboard' with metric cards stat-shipped/stat-progress/stat-total/stat-db, env banner env-verdict, and shipping-table with rows shipping-row-{book_code}. Distribution → Dashboard button is data-testid='open-publish-dashboard' near the top of /distribution. Book identity editor: edit-identity-btn → edit-identity-form → edit-title-input/edit-subtitle-input/edit-author-input → save-identity-btn / cancel-identity-btn. Publish tab is btn-publish; the always-editable pricing lives inside data-testid='pricing-input' (contains an <input type='number'>) with data-testid='approve-pricing-btn' (label toggles between 'Approve Price' and 'Update Price') and data-testid='pricing-approved-text' when a price already exists. Value is prefilled from book.pricing.paperback_price || book.pricing.list_price. All flows work end-to-end.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bugs found. The only recurring console warning is the emergent visual-editor injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>, which is a preview-mode-only wrapper and does not affect the deployed app.
